label: GO after a reward with saturated a2 preference, mid-episode only
explanation: Fires only at GO (0 activations at D1/D2), only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=0 at GO, prev_reward=1 in 100% of activations), and essentially only when the agent chooses a2 (11824/11825), with its policy logit(a1)-logit(a2) in the most extreme bin (< -8.91, all mass); tightening to choice < -9.2 is needed for precision. A strong and unexpected dependence on episode time: no activity in trials 0-9 or 80-99, peaking at trials 50-69, so the predicate restricts to ep_trial 25-71 (dev F1 0.79, mass recall 0.97 vs F1 0.25 without the time window). This suggests the unit reads a slowly drifting hidden-state component (an implicit episode clock or accumulated a2/S2 confidence) together with the saturated a2 policy. Magnitude in example windows is largest on the first rewarded GO after a run of a2->S2 common trials and decays over consecutive rewarded trials (e.g. 0.72, 0.22, 0.01); not systematically checked. Does not fire on a1 choices, after unrewarded trials, or on non-GO steps. Uses only observed variables plus the model's own policy logit; no future variables.
